facts.text: Westminster charges no standard tuition for May Term Study Experiences; instead, students pay an administrative fee of $100 per credit ($400 for a 4-credit course) plus travel expenses.

sources.title: May Term Study Experiences - Westminster University
sources.quote: Standard tuition is not charged for May Term Study Experience courses. Instead, a $100 per credit administrative fee is charged in addition to the travel expenses. Each MTSE course is 4 credits, therefore the administrative fee is $400 per MTSE.
